title.en: Farey spacing and the analytic large sieve
title.zh: 法里分数间距与解析大筛

description.en: Bound the total squared size of a trigonometric sum sampled at reduced fractions with denominator at most Q. The estimate is uniform in the starting frequency.
description.zh: 估计三角和在分母不超过 Q 的既约分数处的模平方总和。该估计对起始频率一致成立。
